fields.name: Sex
fields.description: Sex of the patient.

fields.name: Date of birth - accuracy
fields.description: Indicates whether only the year is reliably known (M), whether year and month are reliably known (T), or whether neither year nor month is reliably known (V). Note: Day is generally not transmitted to ZfKD by the registries.

categories.label: year is accurate, month is estimated

fields.name: Date of birth
fields.description: Patient's date of birth in international date format YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: Deceased
fields.description: Vital status: indicates whether the patient has died (Yes/No).

fields.name: Date of death or last known alive date - accuracy
fields.description: Indicates whether only the year is reliably known (M), whether year and month are reliably known (T), or whether neither year nor month is reliably known (V). Note: Day is generally not transmitted to ZfKD by the registries.

categories.label: year is accurate, month is estimated

fields.name: Date of death or last known alive date
fields.description: If Deceased = No, this variable indicates the date of the most recent vital status ascertainment. If Deceased = Yes, this variable indicates the imputed date of death. For DCO cases, date of death and diagnosis date are set equal.

fields.name: Underlying cause of death (official)
fields.description: Indicates whether the coded cause of death was reported as the official underlying cause per the death certificate, or as transmitted by the state statistical office.

fields.name: Other cause of death, ICD-10 code
fields.description: Additional cause(s) of death on file at the registry, coded per ICD-10.

fields.name: Other cause of death, ICD-10 version
fields.description: ICD-10 edition used to code additional causes of death.

fields.name: Diagnosis date - accuracy
fields.description: Indicates whether only the year is reliably known (M), whether year and month are reliably known (T), or whether neither year nor month is reliably known (V).

categories.label: year is accurate, month is estimated

fields.name: Diagnosis date
fields.description: Date of initial diagnosis in international date format YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: Place of residence at diagnosis
fields.description: First 5 digits of the official municipality code (Gemeindeschlüssel) for the patient's place of residence at the time of initial diagnosis.

fields.name: Tumor diagnosis, ICD-10 code
fields.description: Tumor diagnosis coded per ICD-10.

fields.name: Tumor diagnosis, ICD-10 version
fields.description: ICD-10 edition used to code the tumor diagnosis.

fields.name: Topography of tumor, ICD-O-3 code
fields.description: Coding of tumor site per ICD-O-3.

fields.name: Morphology of tumor, ICD-O-3 code
fields.description: Coding of histology findings per ICD-O-3.

fields.name: Morphology of tumor, ICD-O-3 version (or: WHO Blue Books)
fields.description: Reference used to code tumor morphology (ICD-O-3 or WHO Blue Books).

fields.description: Maximum diameter of the ductal carcinoma in situ (in mm).

fields.description: Pre-therapeutic menopausal status of the patient. Postmenopausal means: either no menstrual bleeding for longer than one year, or E2 and FSH within the postmenopausal range.

fields.name: Estrogen receptor status
fields.description: Estrogen receptor status per immunoreactive score (IRS).

fields.description: Progesterone receptor status per immunoreactive score (IRS).

fields.description: HER2 (ERBB2) status.

categories.label: positive (IHC+++ or IHC++ with positive ISH)
